title: Greenply
extract: Greenply Industries Limited (Greenply), is an Indian interior infrastructure company, headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal. The company is listed on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) and the Bombay Stock Exchange. Greenply has a presence with 55 branches (including virtual branches) and 7,500+ channel partners across India. With state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in West Bengal, Nagaland & Gujarat, and overseas manufacturing units in Gabon (West Africa) & Myanmar, Greenply is making its presence felt across the globe.
